faq.q: What is the origin of Maleyka?
faq.a: Maleyka is associated with Arabic. Maleyka is the Azerbaijani form of Arabic مَلِيكَة (Malīka), meaning 'queen'.
Yes — the underlying form مَلِيكَة is Arabic.
Maleyka can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Maleyka should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Malīka is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Maleyka mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Maleyka is rendered ملکه and carries the sense ملکه، ملکه.
A romanized syllable approximation is ma-ley-ka. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Maleyka, maleyka. Script forms are مليکه, ملکه, ملیکہ, مَلِيكَة, मलैका.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
